The halfway rounding logic contradicts the docstring. The docstring specifies: "a time exactly halfway between two boundaries rounds up to the later one" (always round up). The code implements banker's rounding instead (round-half-to-even), which sometimes rounds down when the quotient is even. This causes the code to not match the stated specification. For example, 09:15 with 30-minute slots should snap to 09:30 per the docstring, but the code makes it snap to 09:00.

Since the instructions state "the docstrings are the source of truth for how this code should behave," the code should implement "always round up when halfway" rather than banker's rounding. The test `test_morning_standup_half_hour_slot` appears to expect banker's rounding behavior that contradicts the docstring specification.
